name: Sampre Nutritions Limited
about: Sampre Nutritions Limited operates as a confectionery manufacturer in India and internationally. It offers éclairs, candies, toffees, powder, and center filled products primarily to MNCs. The company also provides wide range of food, beverage, healthcare, and personal care products, including soft drinks, cosmetics, and therapeutic items. The company sells its products under Sampre brand name. Sampre Nutritions Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Medchal, India.
